title: CATI Alpha V2 post-hoc economic diagnosis
grain: one immutable label_id per V2 mechanism/instrument/decision; not independent executed trades
historical_scope: Only queries bounded strictly before reserved cutoff; whole-period manifests were read as declarative metadata only.
forward_scope: New received-at public observations are independent observe evidence, not reserved historical holdout queries.
data_sources: bounded repository SQLite inventory and declarative manifests
limitations: MFE/MAE are terminal-bar censored bounds, not exact path ordering.
Holding time is a within-bar interval; modeled funding reserves the full 12h horizon.
Turnover is hypothetical candidate turnover, not executable portfolio turnover.
Regimes/deciles and all subgroup outcomes are post-hoc diagnostic only.
HAC variance-equivalent ESS and Kish block units are approximations, not certified independent evidence counts.
15m noise cannot be causally identified without a separately frozen timeframe experiment.
87.689% of combined labels have UNKNOWN static instrument group; unknown is excluded from group-cluster inference.
Historical feature ingestion occurred later than observation: reconstructed causal source time, not a proven historical data-vintage snapshot.
Candidate outcomes do not establish achievable portfolio turnover or actual broker costs.
